[ASSISTANT_SAID] Droopy leaves on a fiddle leaf fig can be caused by overwatering, underwatering, humidity issues, light conditions, temperature, being root bound, or pests/diseases.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To check soil moisture, user should stick their finger into the soil up to the first knuckle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fiddle leaf figs prefer well-draining soil and can be prone to root rot if the soil is too moist.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fiddle leaf figs prefer humidity above 50% and can benefit from a tray with water and pebbles or a humidifier.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fiddle leaf figs thrive in bright, indirect light and prefer temperatures between 65°F to 75°F (18°C to 24°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can prune damaged or dying leaves from Freddy to encourage new growth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should fertilize Orchy with a balanced fertilizer specifically formulated for orchids, diluted to half strength, once a month during the growing season.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can also use a foliar spray fertilizer on Orchy's leaves for additional nutrients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pruning Basilica should involve pinching off flower buds, cutting back long stems above a node, and harvesting individual leaves to encourage bushiness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should prune Basilica regularly to keep it from flowering.
